bekker:1831.author: Bekker, Immanuel (ed.)
bekker:1831.work: Aristotelis Opera, edidit Academia Regia Borussica, Vols. I–II (Berlin: Georg Reimer, 1831; Oxford repr. 1837)
bekker:1831.notes: Canonical Greek critical text defining universal Bekker page, column (a/b), and line coordinates.

ross:metaphysics:1924.author: Ross, Sir William David (ed.)
ross:metaphysics:1924.work: Aristotle's Metaphysics: A Revised Text with Introduction and Commentary, 2 vols. (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1924)
ross:metaphysics:1924.notes: Standard critical Greek edition and commentary for Liber V of this Codex.

ross:physics:1936.author: Ross, Sir William David (ed.)
ross:physics:1936.work: Aristotle's Physics: A Revised Text with Introduction and Commentary (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1936)
ross:physics:1936.notes: Standard critical commentary on Aristotle's abstraction, infinite, place, and continuum treatises.

ross:analytics:1949.author: Ross, Sir William David (ed.)
ross:analytics:1949.work: Aristotle's Prior and Posterior Analytics: A Revised Text with Introduction and Commentary (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1949)
ross:analytics:1949.notes: Comprehensive philological and logical commentary on the Analytics.

waitz:organon:1844.author: Waitz, Theodor (ed.)
waitz:organon:1844.notes: Nineteenth-century critical edition and Latin commentary cited throughout Heath and Hoenen.

bonitz:index:1870.author: Bonitz, Hermann
bonitz:index:1870.work: Index Aristotelicus, Aristotelis Opera Vol. V (Berlin: Georg Reimer, 1870)
bonitz:index:1870.notes: Exhaustive lexicon of Aristotle's Greek philosophical and mathematical terminology.

oxford:works:1908.author: Smith, J. A., and W. D. Ross (eds.)
oxford:works:1908.work: The Works of Aristotle Translated into English, Vols. I–III, VIII (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1908–1931)
oxford:works:1908.notes: Public-domain Oxford English translations by Edghill, Jenkinson, Mure, Pickard-Cambridge, Hardie & Gaye, Stocks, Smith, and Ross staged in this Codex.

heath:euclid:1926.author: Heath, Sir Thomas Little
heath:euclid:1926.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements, 2nd ed., 3 vols. (Cambridge University Press, 1926) [geometor/euclid]
heath:euclid:1926.notes: Contains 145 distinct Aristotelian locus citations reconstructing pre-Euclidean definitions, postulates, and proofs.

heath:math-aristotle:1949.author: Heath, Sir Thomas Little
heath:math-aristotle:1949.notes: Systematic treatise-by-treatise mathematical commentary on every geometrical and arithmetical passage in the Aristotelian corpus.

hoenen:noetica:1952.author: Hoenen, Petrus Hubertus Jacobus, S.J.
hoenen:noetica:1952.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis, Analecta Gregoriana Vol. 56 (Rome: Pontificia Universitas Gregoriana, 1952) [geometor/hoenen]
hoenen:noetica:1952.notes: Contains 64 Aristotelian locus keys developing the noetics of intellectual intuition in the phantasm and intelligible matter.

pacioli:divina:1509.author: Pacioli, Fra Luca, O.F.M.
pacioli:divina:1509.notes: Renaissance treatise citing Aristotle on mathematical certitude, subalternation of perspective/music, and the five regular solids.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:elements.work: Elements (Στοιχεῖα, ed. J. L. Heiberg, Leipzig, 1883–1888)
euclid:elements.notes: The canonical Greek synthesis of definitions, postulates, common notions, plane geometry, Eudoxian proportion, irrationals, and stereometry.

euclid:I.5.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:I.5.notes: Equality of base angles in an isosceles triangle; contrasted with Aristotle's older mixed-angle proof in Prior Analytics I.24 (41b13–22).

euclid:I.29.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:I.29.work: Elements, Book I, Postulate 5 & Proposition 29 (Theory of Parallels)
euclid:I.29.notes: Euclid's resolution of the circularity in parallel-line proofs diagnosed by Aristotle in Prior Analytics II.16 (65a4–9).

euclid:I.32.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:I.32.work: Elements, Book I, Proposition 32 (Interior Angles of a Triangle = 2R)
euclid:I.32.notes: Proved via the parallel through the vertex; cited in Posterior Analytics I.5 (74a25–32), I.31 (87b35), and Metaphysics Θ.9 (1051a24–26).

euclid:III.31.author: Euclid of Alexandria
euclid:III.31.work: Elements, Book III, Proposition 31 (Angle in a Semicircle is Right)
euclid:III.31.notes: Proved in Metaphysics Θ.9 (1051a26–29) and Posterior Analytics II.11 (94a28–34) by erecting the radius from the center of the diameter.

euclid:V.def.5.author: Euclid of Alexandria / Eudoxus of Cnidus
euclid:V.def.5.work: Elements, Book V, Definition 5 & Proposition 16 (General Proportion & Alternation)
euclid:V.def.5.notes: General Eudoxian theory of proportion heralded in Posterior Analytics I.5 (74a17–25) as superseding separate proofs for numbers, lines, solids, and times.

euclid:X.2.author: Euclid of Alexandria / Theaetetus
euclid:X.2.work: Elements, Book X, Propositions 2–3 (Anthyphairetic Criterion of Incommensurability)
euclid:X.2.notes: Geometric preservation of reciprocal subtraction (antanairesis), attested in Topics VIII.3 (158b29–35).

plato:meno.author: Plato
plato:meno.notes: Meno's paradox of inquiry and the geometric doubling of the square, explicitly answered in Posterior Analytics I.1 (71a29).

plato:republic.author: Plato
plato:republic.notes: Distinction between discursive mathematical dianoia from hypotheses and dialectical noēsis.

plato:timaeus.author: Plato
plato:timaeus.notes: Identification of receptacle space (chōra) with matter and construction of physical bodies out of elementary plane triangles—critiqued in Physics IV.2 and De Caelo III.7–8.

proclus:in-euclidem.author: Proclus Diadochus
proclus:in-euclidem.work: In Primum Euclidis Elementorum Librum Commentarii (ed. G. Friedlein, Leipzig, 1873)
proclus:in-euclidem.notes: Preserves the Eudemian summary of Greek geometry and compares Aristotelian axioms, postulates, and hypotheses with Euclid's Elements.

alexander:in-metaph.author: Alexander of Aphrodisias
alexander:in-metaph.work: In Aristotelis Metaphysica Commentaria (ed. M. Hayduck, CAG I, Berlin, 1891)
alexander:in-metaph.notes: Classical Peripatetic commentary on Metaphysics A–Δ (with pseudo-Alexander / Michael of Ephesus on E–N).

simplicius:in-physica.author: Simplicius of Cilicia
simplicius:in-physica.work: In Aristotelis Physicorum Libros Commentaria (ed. H. Diels, CAG IX–X, Berlin, 1882–1895)
simplicius:in-physica.notes: Essential source on Antiphon, Bryson, Hippocrates of Chios, and Zeno's continuum arguments.

philoponus:in-anal-post.author: John Philoponus
philoponus:in-anal-post.work: In Aristotelis Analytica Priora et Posteriora Commentaria (ed. M. Wallies, CAG XIII.2–3, Berlin, 1905–1909)
philoponus:in-anal-post.notes: Preserves ancient reconstructions of Aristotle's geometric examples in the Analytics.

aquinas:in-anal-post.author: Thomas Aquinas, St., O.P.
aquinas:in-anal-post.work: Expositio Libri Posteriorum Analyticorum (Leonine ed., Vol. I*2, Rome, 1989)
aquinas:in-anal-post.notes: Scholastic exposition of demonstrative science, axioms vs. postulates, subalternation, and intuitive epagōgē.

aquinas:in-boeth-trin.author: Thomas Aquinas, St., O.P.
aquinas:in-boeth-trin.work: Super Boethium De Trinitate (Leonine ed., Vol. L, Rome, 1992)
aquinas:in-boeth-trin.notes: Locus classicus on the three degrees of theoretical distinction/abstraction and the termination of mathematical judgment in the imagination (ad imaginationem).

averroes:in-metaph.author: Averroes (Ibn Rushd)
averroes:in-metaph.work: Aristotelis Metaphysicorum Libri XIIII cum Averrois Cordubensis in eosdem Commentariis (Venice: Junta, 1562)
averroes:in-metaph.notes: Classical Peripatetic-Arabic exposition of Metaphysics α.3 (995a14–17) on mathematical exactitude (akribeia) and abstraction from sensible matter.

hilbert:grundlagen:1899.author: Hilbert, David
hilbert:grundlagen:1899.notes: Modern formalist axiomatization contrasted with Aristotelian intuitive first principles in the Codex commentary.
